description: Actual local inference for detector-guided dense and notebook recovery; failed candidates and the model-server stall are retained separately.
hash_convention: SHA-256, text CRLF normalized to LF; binary files hashed verbatim.

server.hardware: RTX 3080 10 GiB; Surya detection on CPU
server.arguments: --ctx-size 8192 --parallel 1 --gpu-layers 99 --flash-attn on --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --batch-size 256 --ubatch-size 128 --cache-ram 256 --chat-template-file <official LightOn template> --reasoning off

inference.regional_faint_ink: Minimum RGB channel when light background >=85%, faint chromatic pixels are 0.05%-3%, and fewer than 20% survive a 5-pixel erosion. Source backgrounds unchanged.

controls.references: Dense v3 adds 16 source-verified printed lines; prior 365 annotations unchanged. Notes v2 unchanged.
controls.comparison: Old and new predictions rescored with identical current references and formatter. No tolerance changes.
controls.baselines: Actual full runs use an empty baseline directory; no cross-model regression gate is claimed. The existing olmOCR dense control was rescored from the same frozen predictions for reference v3; its prior version remains archived.
controls.focused_code: Both live-complete final matrices use the recorded runtime implementation, including zoomed detection, gutter-bounded padding and empty-region preservation. Earlier candidate matrices and failed assertions are retained separately.
controls.failed_candidate: full-grounded-v6 rendered the initial view at 400 dpi and failed Halting/FK. Final code retains the established initial rendering and loads detailed pixels lazily.
controls.host_stall: live-hybrid-v9 includes a 240-second cancelled request. Server generation paused at token 386 for over three minutes. The failure remains recorded; the affected test is rerun separately.
controls.cell_merge: Visual PDF inspection exposed a misplaced duplicate schema label after the earlier live checks passed. A stricter duplicate-count assertion failed in live-cell-hybrid-v10. Final code anchors isolated source lines and merges unique coarse duplicates into their precise rereads. before-cell-merge-grounded is an intentionally interrupted partial run, superseded by both complete final runs.
controls.empty_regions: empty-region-failure-grounded is a complete failed run: page 13 was discarded when detected bullets/dots returned empty native responses. Source inspection confirmed non-text marks. Completed empty regional responses now follow the existing empty-JSON contract, while empty pages, malformed nonempty data and truncation still fail. The final notebook cases include source page 13.
controls.harness_location: Harnesses ran under .cache/dense-notes-20261024; their project-root assumptions use that path.
controls.zoomed_detection: Before-zoom corpus runs passed sparse checks but missed dense printed exercise text. Tiled source detection recovered 16 omitted lines. The first zoomed crop included a clipped neighboring question and invented a table; gutter-bounded padding removed that fragment. Final live assertions cover all three printed questions and reject the invented Value table. Before-zoom runs use commit 30a3cf3112706cb947a3aa9eb0f2f2524ca26bf7.
controls.selection_harness: The old trace assumed one render/request per selected page and falsely rejected lazy detailed rendering. The revised trace distinguishes whole-page and regional requests by pixel hashes and still forbids any unselected source-page render.
controls.empty_native_tags: The complete v13 grounded run failed on notebook page 6 when a valid native coordinate marker had no text content. Such completed empty regional blocks now follow the empty-string/JSON contract; malformed markers and empty pages still fail. The retained failed run excludes stale pre-zoom response names by timestamp.
controls.supplementary_overlap: A full-run PDF export exposed Snowball in a neighboring column after a zoomed detector merged existing lines. Supplemental geometry now rejects overlap relative to either rectangle. The interrupted partial run and failed export assertion are retained under overlap-failure.
controls.colored_ink: The actual hybrid later-page test read faint cyan reachable as readable. The exact same crop, prompt and model reproduce readable with original colors and reachable with minimum-channel contrast. The original images, responses and failed live test remain retained; no transcription dictionary or fixture lookup is used.
controls.row_anchors: Visual inspection of the corrected transcription still found reachable above its source row in the seeded hybrid PDF. The stricter assertion fails against the saved output. Nearby equal-count rows in one column now retain source order; ambiguous columns and distant rows keep spatial matching. before-row-anchors retains the completed grounded candidate and intentionally interrupted hybrid corpus run.
controls.paragraph_rows: Visual inspection found joined printed paragraphs squeezed onto a single detected row. The stricter source-row checks fail against the saved pre-expansion PDF. Regular ordered paragraphs now distribute unchanged words over their source rows, preserving inline math; irregular layouts retain existing matching.

raw_archive.note: Expanded contents were audited before packing; every member retains its own hash in files.
